text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, this is unexpected...!
I never thought we'd get this much!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"A wise hawk hides its talons," or so they say... If I'd known this would happen,
I would've watched my hands much more closely...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, no, just talking to myself.
You did a good job, seriously.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "It's not like I'm trying to steal your techniques or anything♪"
